newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks cut losses, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks cut losses, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips cut their losses in late afternoon trading Wednesday, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to lift curbs on program trading at 1442 EDT/1842 GMT.
The Dow Industrials were off 21 points at 7739. The Standard & Poor's 500 Index was off three points at 891.

The Nasdaq composite index, also off its lows, was down seven points to 1436. The index was suffering deeper losses, about 0.5 percent, than other broad-based stock indexes after two key technology companies forecast disappointing earnings.

Gateway 2000 Inc said late Tuesday that second-quarter revenues would be flat compared to the first quarter. Seagate Technology Inc said its quarterly results would not meet Wall Street analysts' estimates.
The long bond was up 14/32 to yield 6.69 percent.
